summary: @ornikar/kitt2 preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package declares itself as a React/Tamagui UI kit but ships a `preinstall` hook (`node setup.mjs`) whose loader is obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style identifier renaming. On install, setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases (oven-sh/bun) into a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it on a sibling `math_init.js` file (~728 KB) that is itself heavily obfuscated with a rotated string-array decoder and a large constant table. Fetching an alternate runtime at install time solely to execute an opaque, obfuscated bundled blob is not the standard prebuilt-native-binary pattern and does not match the package's stated purpose as a UI component library; the payload's actual behavior is hidden from review by the obfuscation. The end result is that `npm install` causes execution of opaque code on the installer's machine under a downloaded non-Node runtime, bypassing Node-based inspection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
